def find_cluster_info(s):
    parts = s.split()
    special = [(i, int(v)) for i, v in enumerate(parts) if v != "5"]
    if not special:
        return len(special)
    min_col = min(i for i, v in special)
    # Group by distance from min
    distances = [i - min_col for i, v in special]
    unique_vals = set(v for i, v in special)
    first_vals = [(i-min_col, v) for i, v in special if i == min_col + distances[0]]
    return min_col, unique_vals, distances, special

print("\n--- Cluster analysis ---")
for r_str in [row1_str, row19_str, row26_str]:
